blind.description: An architectural ball finial composed of a square plinth base, a turned circular neck moulding, and a smooth spherical finial top. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no holes or floating elements. The material is a mottled, weathered pale-beige and greenish marble or limestone.
blind.from_above: A textured mottled sphere centred directly over the corners of a square plinth, casting a teardrop-shaped shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the figure (around 1.5 to 2 feet tall) and roughly one-half the figure's cylinder diameter in width.
